title: Night Porter
source: Hallways Originals #3 (lab/genres/soul.py), developed into a full piece Oct 25 2026

parts.name: Bass line
parts.description: The boogaloo riff; a walk in the solo, a two-feel in the breakdown.

parts.name: Groove
parts.description: The boogaloo groove; hats and rim in the breakdown; fills; a roll and a button to end.

parts.name: Chords
parts.description: Offbeat chops; quiet stabs in the breakdown.

parts.name: Held chords
parts.description: An organ swell, comping under the solo, soft chords through the breakdown.

parts.name: Melody
parts.description: The head; the whispered tune; calls in the trading chorus; the shout's top line.

parts.name: Answers
parts.description: The horn answers -- and a whole solo chorus.

parts.name: Harmony
parts.description: Answers' middle voice; the replies in the trading chorus; the shout's harmony.

parts.name: Low harmony
parts.description: The lowest horn; a slow countermelody in the breakdown.
